SELECT count(*) FROM bd_student WHERE id NOT IN ( SELECT student_id FROM bd_student_class WHERE class_id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 and student_id != '') AND is_ordinary = 0 AND is_delete = 0 AND mec_id = #{mecId} AND campus_id = #{campusId}
and student_name like CONCAT('%',#{studentName},'%')

select cou.course_name, cls_info.class_name, cr.id, cr.total_number, cr.remaining_number from bd_course_time cr left join bd_student stu on stu.id = cr.student_id left join bd_course cou on cou.id = cr.course_id left join ( select cls.class_name class_name, stu_cls.student_id student_id, stu_cls.class_id class_id, cls.class_course_id class_course_id from bd_class cls, bd_student_class stu_cls where stu_cls.class_id = cls.id and stu_cls.student_id = #{studentId} and stu_cls.is_delete = 0 ) cls_info on stu.id = cls_info.student_id and cr.course_id = cls_info.class_course_id where cr.student_id = #{studentId} and cr.is_delete = 0
